_note: S34 stylist packs — the brief's 'multiple stylist agents, one per product type and theme type', expressed as DATA rather than as N code paths. One agent reads the matching pack. A new genre is a JSON entry, not a deploy. Each pack carries where this apparel is shot, how the model carries it, what may be styled around it, and what is WRONG for the genre. `locations` is the L1 stage pool: 3 per genre, chosen deterministically by SKU hash so a collection is coherent without every SKU looking identical. NO pack may contain legible text/signage — that rule is global (plan §12).
_match_note: Selection is keyword-first over the tag-read product description + detected category, falling back to 'everyday'. Keywords are matched case-insensitively as substrings.

everyday.label: Everyday Casual
everyday.pov: Elevated everyday — clothes a real person actually leaves the house in, shot with the care usually reserved for luxury. Warm, unforced, aspirational but reachable.
locations: a sunlit European boutique courtyard: weathered stone archways with real depth, wrought-iron balconies, terracotta planters with olive and bougainvillea, a linen-covered café table, worn stone paving falling away into soft bokeh
a quiet old-town side street in warm morning light: pastel plaster walls, shuttered windows, a bicycle against stone, potted geraniums, long soft shadows across the cobbles
a bright minimal loft interior: tall windows with sheer linen, pale oak floor, a single ceramic vase, clean negative space and soft north light
everyday.light: warm directional late-morning sun, soft-edged shadows
everyday.styling: plain unbranded tailored trousers or straight jeans in a neutral tone, simple leather sandals or clean minimal sneakers, at most one fine gold piece
everyday.energy: relaxed and self-possessed, natural weight shifts, unhurried
everyday.avoid: gym clothing, evening wear, heavy jewellery, formal tailoring

formal.label: Formal / Workwear
formal.pov: Contemporary power dressing. Architectural, composed, quietly expensive. The garment's cut and line are the entire story.
locations: a modern glass-and-stone office atrium: clean vertical lines, a wide staircase, polished concrete, cool daylight raking through tall glazing
a marble lobby with deep columns and a long reflective floor, restrained and symmetrical, soft ambient bounce
an urban crossing in early-morning light: crisp architecture, wide pavement, long shadows, city depth compressed behind
formal.light: cool clean daylight with controlled contrast, crisp shadow edges
formal.styling: sharply tailored complementary separates, polished leather loafers or heeled mules, a structured unbranded leather bag, minimal metal jewellery
formal.energy: upright and deliberate, purposeful stride, calm authority
formal.avoid: beachwear, athletic clothing, rustic or bohemian props, messy layering

ethnic_indian.label: Indian Ethnic
ethnic_indian.pov: Indian heritage craft, photographed with reverence for drape and handwork. The fall of the fabric and the detail of the embroidery carry the frame.
locations: a heritage haveli courtyard: carved sandstone jharokha windows, scalloped arches, an inlaid stone floor, brass planters, warm filtered afternoon light
a colonnaded verandah of an old palace: lime-washed pillars, jaali screens casting patterned shade, a worn stone step, deep warm shadow
a terrace at golden hour with weathered lime plaster walls, marigold in brass urns, a hand-block-printed textile draped over a low wall
ethnic_indian.light: warm golden low-angle light, rich saturated shadow, gentle haze
ethnic_indian.styling: traditional complementary pieces only — matching dupatta drape, juttis or embellished flats, delicate gold jhumkas and bangles, never Western casualwear
ethnic_indian.energy: poised and graceful, elongated posture, fabric caught mid-movement, hands expressive and soft
ethnic_indian.avoid: Western street settings, sneakers, denim, modern office backdrops, gym contexts

festive.label: Festive / Occasion
festive.pov: Celebration wear. Light is the subject as much as the garment — the way it catches embellishment, sequin and sheen.
locations: a candlelit heritage interior at dusk: carved wooden columns, warm lamplight pooling, marigold garlands out of focus, deep amber shadow
a courtyard at blue hour with strung warm festoon lights overhead, rangoli patterns on stone, glowing bokeh behind
an ornate mirrored hall with soft directional warm light and rich reflected highlights
festive.light: warm low ambient with strong specular highlights on embellishment, dusk or evening
festive.styling: occasion footwear, statement earrings, an embellished clutch, hair dressed rather than casual
festive.energy: elegant and dynamic, fabric in motion, a sense of turning into the light
festive.avoid: daytime casual settings, sportswear, flat lighting, minimal styling

activewear.label: Activewear / Gym
activewear.pov: Performance and capability, not decoration. Bodies in motion, sweat-real, functional. Fabric technology is the hero — compression, stretch, breathability.
locations: a functional training gym: matte black rigging, rubber flooring, weight racks softly out of focus, cool directional window light cutting across
an urban rooftop at dawn: painted running lines, city skyline hazy behind, cool blue early light and long shadows
a concrete stairwell or underpass with strong graphic geometry, cool daylight from one end, hard-edged shadow
activewear.light: cool crisp directional light, high contrast, defined shadow edges, no softening
activewear.styling: matched technical separates in a muted tone, performance trainers, a simple water bottle or gym towel, hair tied back, no jewellery
activewear.energy: athletic and mid-motion — stretching, mid-stride, recovering, breathing. Never a static fashion pose
activewear.avoid: cafés, heritage architecture, jewellery, heels, loose flowing fabric, soft romantic light

sportswear.label: Performance Sport / Outdoor
sportswear.pov: Sport as it is actually played. Weather, ground, effort. Documentary energy rather than studio polish.
locations: a stadium tunnel opening onto a floodlit pitch, deep shadow to bright, atmospheric haze
an outdoor athletics track in low golden light, lane markings receding, heat shimmer
a mountain trail at dawn: cold air, mist between pines, wet rock underfoot
sportswear.light: dramatic natural light — dawn, dusk or floodlight, strong rim separation
sportswear.styling: sport-appropriate technical layers, running or trail shoes, a cap or headband, no fashion accessories
sportswear.energy: genuine physical effort — running, climbing, mid-exertion, breath visible in cold air
sportswear.avoid: urban fashion posing, indoor luxury, styling props, static standing

loungewear.label: Loungewear / Sleepwear
loungewear.pov: Softness and calm. Domestic intimacy, morning light, nothing performed. Comfort is the product.
locations: a sunlit bedroom: rumpled white linen, a pale wooden headboard, sheer curtains diffusing morning light, a book face-down
a quiet minimal apartment corner: a linen armchair, ceramic mug on a low table, plants, soft window light
a bright kitchen in early morning: pale cabinetry, steam from a cup, warm low sun across a worktop
loungewear.light: soft diffused morning window light, low contrast, gentle falloff
loungewear.styling: bare feet or simple slippers, no jewellery, hair loose and undone, a mug or open book as a natural prop
loungewear.energy: unposed and languid — curled, leaning, stretching on waking, gaze away from camera
loungewear.avoid: outdoor city settings, heels, formal styling, hard light, structured posing

denim.label: Denim
denim.pov: Denim is texture and attitude. Wash, whiskering, hardware and fit are the whole story — shoot them hard and honest.
locations: a sunlit Mediterranean old-town street: pale stone paving, whitewashed walls, bougainvillea spilling over a doorway, café tables and rattan chairs, warm late-morning light and soft shadow
an industrial loft: raw brick, steel-framed windows, worn timber floor, hard side light and deep shadow
a sunlit brick alley with a painted plain wall, weathered surfaces, strong graphic light
a desert roadside in late light: dusty asphalt, open sky, warm rim light along the silhouette
denim.light: hard directional light that reveals wash, whiskering and seam texture
denim.styling: a plain unbranded fitted tee or simple knit tucked or half-tucked, leather boots or clean sneakers, a simple belt
denim.energy: confident and casual, hands in pockets, weight cocked, effortless
denim.avoid: delicate romantic settings, formal interiors, heavy jewellery, soft flat light

swim_resort.label: Swim / Resort
swim_resort.pov: Sun, water and ease. Light on skin and fabric, salt and heat. Editorial, never gratuitous.
locations: a pool edge at midday: turquoise water, white stone coping, a single striped towel, sharp bright light
a rocky Mediterranean cove: clear shallow water, pale rock, sea haze on the horizon
a shaded resort terrace: rattan furniture, palm shadow patterns across pale plaster, warm bounce light
swim_resort.light: bright high sun with clean specular highlights on water and skin, or warm late-afternoon glow
swim_resort.styling: bare feet or simple flat raffia/leather sandals, and sunglasses. Nothing worn over the swimwear on any frame
swim_resort.energy: relaxed and sun-warmed, walking out of water, adjusting a strap, natural and unstudied
swim_resort.avoid: urban settings, cold light, formal posing, and ANY garment worn over the swimwear — no cover-up, kaftan, sarong, shirt, trousers, shorts or skirt

winterwear.label: Winter / Outerwear
winterwear.pov: Warmth made visible. Volume, layering and loft — the garment's bulk and how it moves in cold air.
locations: a misty pine forest path: cold blue light, fog between trunks, damp ground, breath visible
an alpine village street in winter light: stone buildings, snow-dusted rooflines, warm window glow behind
a weathered stone cabin exterior at dusk: bare branches, cold clear air, low warm sun on the horizon
winterwear.light: cool overcast or low winter sun, soft directional, blue shadow with warm highlight
winterwear.styling: layered unbranded knitwear beneath, boots, a plain scarf or beanie, gloves held rather than worn
winterwear.energy: hands in pockets, shoulders raised against cold, walking with intent, collar turned up
winterwear.avoid: summer settings, bare skin, tropical light, sandals

streetwear.label: Streetwear / Youth
streetwear.pov: Culture-first. Proportion, attitude and place. Slightly raw, deliberately imperfect framing.
locations: a concrete underpass with strong geometry and graphic shadow, no lettering on any surface
a skate park at golden hour: worn concrete bowls, chain-link fence, dust in the low light
a metro platform or stairwell with hard fluorescent-and-daylight mix and cool tiled surfaces
streetwear.light: mixed hard light, deliberate contrast, some flare tolerated
streetwear.styling: oversized plain unbranded layers, chunky sneakers, a plain cap or crossbody bag
streetwear.energy: loose and off-hand — mid-movement, leaning, seated on steps, gaze away from camera
streetwear.avoid: heritage luxury settings, delicate styling, formal posture, soft romantic light

luxury.label: Luxury Editorial
luxury.pov: Restraint and material. Very few elements, each one considered. The fabric's fall and sheen carry everything.
locations: a marble gallery with deep columns and a single shaft of directional light across polished stone
a minimal boutique interior: pale plaster, a single sculptural chair, controlled pooled light
a colonnade at dusk with long architectural shadows and a limited restrained palette
luxury.light: controlled directional light with deliberate falloff, rich shadow, minimal fill
luxury.styling: one considered accessory at most, fine leather footwear, nothing that competes with the garment
luxury.energy: still, sculptural, elongated — a held moment rather than an action
luxury.avoid: busy backgrounds, casual props, harsh flat light, cluttered styling
